Title: End-to-end valid listing creation with all required and optional fields
Preconditions: User is logged in and on the Create Listing form.
Steps:
1. Upload 2 valid JPG/PNG photos (<10 MB each).
2. Enter Title: 'Vintage Mechanical Keyboard'.
3. Select leaf Category 'Electronics > Keyboards'.
4. Select Condition: 'Like new'.
5. Enter Price: 150.
6. Enter valid Description without phone numbers.
7. Check both Meetup (select valid location from dropdown) and Delivery (fee: 10).
8. Click 'List it'.
Expected Result: 'List it' button enables once valid; listing is created and published with all entered attributes.

Title: Photo upload validation (count, format, file size, and rejected files not counting toward limit)
Preconditions: User is on Create Listing form.
Steps:
1. Verify error when 0 photos are added.
2. Attempt to upload a GIF/WEBP file and an 11 MB JPG file.
3. Upload 10 valid HEIC/PNG/JPG photos.
4. Attempt to upload an 11th valid photo.
Expected Result: Appropriate error messages display for 0 photos, unsupported type ('Only JPG, PNG or HEIC files are supported'), and >10 MB ('Each photo must be under 10 MB'); rejected files do not consume the 10-photo quota; 11th valid photo triggers 'You can add up to 10 photos'.

Title: Title validation (whitespace trimming, 5-80 length, and max 3 consecutive identical characters)
Preconditions: User is on Create Listing form.
Steps:
1. Enter '   abc   ' and blur.
2. Enter an 81-character string and blur.
3. Enter 'Gooooood phone' (6 consecutive 'o's) and blur.
4. Enter 'Goood phone' (3 consecutive 'o's) and blur.
Expected Result: Steps 1 and 2 show 'Title must be 5–80 characters'; Step 3 shows 'Title can't repeat the same character more than 3 times in a row'; Step 4 passes validation.

Title: Category leaf selection and state preservation when changing categories
Preconditions: User has filled out Title, Price, and Photos on Create Listing form.
Steps:
1. Select a parent category that has subcategories and blur.
2. Select a valid leaf category.
3. Switch to a different valid leaf category.
Expected Result: Parent category shows 'Choose a more specific category'; selecting a leaf category clears the error; changing categories preserves Title, Price, Photos, and other entered fields.

Title: Price validation (0 displays as 'Free', max 9,999,999, decimals and negatives rejected)
Preconditions: User is on Create Listing form.
Steps:
1. Enter 0 in Price and publish/preview.
2. Enter -1, 10.99, and 10000000 in Price.
Expected Result: Price 0 is accepted and displays as 'Free'; negative, decimal, and >9,999,999 values show 'Enter a price between 0 and 9,999,999'.

Title: Description phone number detection (spaces/dashes stripped) and 4,000 char limit
Preconditions: User is on Create Listing form.
Steps:
1. Enter 'Model 1234567' (7 digits) in Description.
2. Enter 'Call me at 9123 4567' and '9123-4567' (8 digits with space/dash).
3. Enter 4,001 characters in Description.
Expected Result: 7 digits is allowed; 8+ digits ignoring spaces/dashes triggers 'For your safety, don't include phone numbers in the description'; >4,000 chars triggers 'Description can be up to 4,000 characters'.

Title: Deal method conditional fields (Meetup location search, Delivery fee 0-500) and uncheck clearing
Preconditions: User is on Create Listing form.
Steps:
1. Leave both Meetup and Delivery unchecked.
2. Check Meetup, type free text without selecting from search results.
3. Select valid location, then uncheck Meetup and re-check it.
4. Check Delivery, enter 501, then enter 50, then uncheck Delivery.
Expected Result: No deal method selected shows 'Choose at least one deal method'; free-text meetup shows 'Pick a meetup location from the list'; fee >500 shows 'Delivery fee must be between 0 and 500'; unchecking Meetup or Delivery clears and hides its respective sub-field.

Title: Server-side validation enforcement when client-side validation is bypassed
Preconditions: User has a valid authentication token and API client.
Steps: 1. Send a direct POST request to the Create Listing API bypassing UI checks with each of these invalid payloads: 4-char title, phone number in description, non-leaf category, delivery fee 600.
Expected Result: Server rejects each invalid request and returns the exact error messages defined in the specification.
Requirement: Create Listing - Server-side Source of Truth
